panels.title: FLOW COLLECTION

targets.rawSql:
SELECT multiIf(countIf(Status = 'ACTIVE') > 0, 2, countIf(Status = 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') > 0, 1, 0) FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)

panels.description: RECEIVING FLOWS = at least one exporter sent flows in the last 5 minutes. IDLE = exporters seen in the last 7 days, none in the last 5 minutes. NO FLOW DATA = no exporter has sent flows in 7 days (expected in a lab without traffic). Neither is an outage: router availability is on the Device Health dashboard.

panels.description: Exporters sending flows that are not a Zabbix host (or are outside the selection when everything is selected). Add them to Zabbix to make them selectable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, ExporterName AS exporter, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, exporter ORDER BY time

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

panels.title: Traffic by ingress interface

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeReceived, INTERVAL greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) SECOND) AS time, concat(ExporterName, ' / ', if(InIfName = '', 'Router-local', InIfName)) AS interface, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/greatest(${res_s}, $__interval_s) AS bps FROM default.${res} WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND (has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName) OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) GROUP BY time, interface ORDER BY time

panels.description: Interface names come from static/SNMP metadata. "Unresolved interface" = no name known for that ifIndex.

defaults.noValue: No data in the selected range

panels.title: Interfaces (last ≤24 h)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction, round(bytes*8/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)))) AS Traffic, round(flows/greatest(1, toUnixTimestamp($__toTime) - toUnixTimestamp(greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR))), 3) AS `Flows/s`, dateDiff('second', lastts, now()) AS `Last flow` FROM (
       SELECT ExporterName AS Exporter, multiIf(InIfName = '', 'Router-local', InIfName = 'ifindex-unmapped', 'Unresolved interface', InIfName) AS Interface, multiIf(InIfName = '', 'Router', InIfBoundary = 'external', 'External', InIfBoundary = 'internal', 'Internal', 'Unclassified') AS Role, if(InIfBoundary = 'external', 'Inbound', 'Ingress') AS Direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes, count() AS flows, max(TimeReceived) AS lastts
          FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND (InIfName = '' OR has([${interface:singlequote}], InIfName)) GROUP BY Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction UNION ALL SELECT ExporterName AS Exporter, multiIf(OutIfName = '', 'Router-local', OutIfName = 'ifindex-unmapped', 'Unresolved interface', OutIfName) AS Interface, multiIf(OutIfName = '', 'Router', OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'External', OutIfBoundary = 'internal', 'Internal', 'Unclassified') AS Role, if(OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'Outbound', 'Egress') AS Direction, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate) AS bytes, count() AS flows, max(TimeReceived) AS lastts
          FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived >= greatest($__fromTime, now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND TimeReceived <= $__toTime AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') AND has([${exporter:singlequote}], ExporterName) AND ('${direction}'='all' OR multiIf(InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary != 'external', 'inbound', OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND InIfBoundary != 'external', 'outbound', InIfBoundary = 'external' AND OutIfBoundary = 'external', 'transit', 'unclassified')='${direction}') AND ('${proto}'='all' OR Proto = toUInt32OrZero('${proto}')) AND (OutIfName = '' OR has([${interface:singlequote}], OutIfName)) GROUP BY Exporter, Interface, Role, Direction) ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Role comes from verified interface boundary metadata. Router-local = traffic to/from the router itself (no output interface). Inbound/Outbound apply to external interfaces; Ingress/Egress to other interfaces. Utilization % is intentionally not shown: interface speed is not verified.

defaults.noValue: No recent flows on any interface for the selected scope.

panels.title: Exporter status

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Exporter, Status, Inventory, Traffic, `Flows/s`, `Last flow` FROM (SELECT l.exporter AS Exporter,
  multiIf(r.ex = '', 'NO DATA', x.ex != '', 'ACTIVE', 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS') AS Status,
  if(has([${device:singlequote}], l.exporter), 'Configured', 'NOT IN INVENTORY') AS Inventory,
  if(x.ex != '', x.bps, 0) AS Traffic, if(x.ex != '', x.fps, 0) AS `Flows/s`, if(r.ex = '', NULL, if(x.ex != '', x.age, r.age)) AS `Last flow`
  FROM (SELECT arrayJoin([${exporter:singlequote}]) AS exporter) AS l
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows_1m0s WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS r ON l.exporter = r.ex
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ExporterName AS ex, sum(Bytes*SamplingRate)*8/300 AS bps, count()/300 AS fps, dateDiff('second', max(TimeReceived), now()) AS age FROM default.flows WHERE TimeReceived > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND (('${scope}'='real' AND ExporterAddress != toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR ('${scope}'='demo' AND ExporterAddress = toIPv6('::ffff:247.16.14.11')) OR '${scope}'='all') GROUP BY ex) AS x ON l.exporter = x.ex)
   ORDER BY multiIf(Status = 'ACTIVE', 0, Status = 'IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS', 1, 2), Exporter

panels.description: Rows = devices configured in Zabbix for the selected scope plus any exporter seen in flows. ACTIVE: flows in the last 5 min. IDLE / NO RECENT FLOWS: seen in the last 7 days but quiet. NO DATA: configured but no flow seen in 7 days — this says nothing about the device being up or down (see Device Health). NOT IN INVENTORY: sends flows but is not a Zabbix host. Traffic and flows/s are 5-minute averages.
